title: Make recurring Buildkite adapter checks green without workflow redesign
intent: Fix the recurring Buildkite adapter failures across standard PR, push, release PR, and master-merge paths while preserving GitHub Actions semantics and protections wherever possible; document each observed failure and exact resolution in one GitHub Issue, then publish a PR.
proof_hooks: GitHub checks for the published PR
stop_conditions: Do not alter GitHub Action workflows unless the recorded Buildkite failure cannot be resolved through repository or GitHub configuration.
Do not weaken release or live-environment protections; preserve existing environment gates or stop for human review.
Publish only after the single issue documents every observed failure case and the PR checks are green or an external Buildkite limitation is explicitly evidenced.
